description: Where pay is per bucket, per box or per row, a break is a pay cut, so the incentive runs directly against the safety advice.
energy_note: Resting costs him by the bucket.

aspect: Chronic kidney disease of unknown origin
description: Repeated heat stress and dehydration in agricultural labour is associated with kidney damage in Mesoamerican working populations - an illness of the job rather than of any single accident.
energy_note: Kidneys, at forty, from the heat.

aspect: Protection varies by state and by administration
description: Heat standards exist in some jurisdictions and not others, and change with politics, so the same work is regulated or not depending on which side of a state line it happens.
energy_note: Legal protection that stops at the county line.

description: It is 41 degrees. The water is at the end of the row, four minutes' walk each way. Eight minutes is most of a bucket, and a bucket is $2.20. He works out he can afford to drink twice more before lunch.
energy_note: Doing arithmetic on how many times he can afford to drink.
